# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "psms",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "psms-theory.html",
    Implementation = "psms-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "psms-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "psms-validation.html"
  )
)
```

PSMS is checked on matched prolate-spheroid modal problems across boundary, frequency, orientation, size, and material-contrast ladders.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
